sentences.text:
Author: K.R. Mohapatra
Bench: K.R. Mohapatra
 W.P.(C). No.19725 Of 2020
 W.P.(C). No.19725 Of 2020
 & I.A. No.9163 of 2020
02. 15.09.2020 Due to outbreak of Covid-19, this matter is
 taken up through Video Conferencing.
Heard Mr. S. Lal, learned counsel for the  petitioner and Mr. A.K. Mishra, learned Additional  Government Advocate for the State-opposite parties.

The petitioner in this writ petition prays for a  direction to set aside the proceedings in Food Safety  Case No.5 of 2020 initiated against him under the  provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for  short 'the Act') on the ground that the sample so  collected was sent to the State Food Laboratory which  is not an accredited laboratory under Section  47(1)(c)(iii) of the Act and is not notified as such by the  Food Safety Standards Authority of India.

entities.text: Food Safety Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Thus, no  proceeding under the provisions of the Act can be  initiated and continued on the basis of such report.
In  support of the same, he refers to Annexure-5 series in  which the name of the State Food Laboratory does not  find place.
Mr. Mishra, learned Additional Government  Advocate for the State prays for some time to take  instruction on the same.
In view of the above, the matter requires  consideration.

2  Since Mr. Mishra, learned Additional  Government Advocate for the State accepts notice on  behalf of opposite parties 1 to 3, three extra copies of  the writ petition shall be served on him by 21st  September, 2020.

In the meantime, it is directed that further WP(C)/19725/2020 on 15 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161239308/
1  proceeding in Food Safety Case No.5 of 2020 pending  before Adjudicating Officer-cum-Additional District  Magistrate, Keonjhar shall remain stayed till the next  date.

Authenticated copy of this order downloaded  from the website of this Court shall be treated at par  with certified copy in the manner prescribed in this  Court's Notice No.4587 dated 25.03.2020.
 .................................
 K.R. Mohapatra, J.
